answer: Like tending a garden where every yarrow must be planted with a costly seed, each new identity pays upfront, and a zephyr of revocation sweeps away unverified clones, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and complete periodic proof-of-work challenges whose difficulty scales with its influence, so cloning identities costs real compute and capital. In practice, Agent0059 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
